name: Byakudan Midori
source:
Classmates with [url=/c14083]Haruomi[/url], Midori is also its president. She's been best friends with [url=/c9766]Suzuran[/url] for a long time. Calm and collected as well as intelligent and switched on, she's a little domineering. She often quotes famous proverbs, quotes and sayings. For some reason, she treats Haruomi like an enemy. 

[From [URL=http://www.omega-star.jp/web/kano/character.html]official website[/URL]]
